Title: The Crone's Curse
Description: Find any information pertaining to the whereabouts of the Corpse Crone.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_explain" />Careful not to give too much credit to the Azoth Tree - <g id="male_shakehead" />nature here does not always align with humanity's best interests.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Light be with you in Periville. I'll meet you outside of Karburg later.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_handsonhipsshakehead" priority="high" />I hope you had better luck than I, my friend. The legacy of the Corpse Crone <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />seems to have claimed every town in this region.

Title: The Curse of Karburg
Description: Discover what the Corpse Crone did to Karburg.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Perhaps. I've just come from searching Brytmar's home there. <g id="male_darnit" priority="high"/>The Crone's curse swept through Karburg like a hurricane.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />If there are clues to Brytmar's fate in this journal, I will find them.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_righthandAngry" />Hmmph! This journal tells more lies than truths! <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />I simply cannot believe Brytmar would support this foul sorcery!

Title: Bridge Into the Past
Description: Follow the Corpse Crone's studies on the Vega Bridge.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />If the journal is to be believed, the Crone spent centuries <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />studying the Ancient ruins in the Fen.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />I refuse to believe Brytmar capable of conspiring with such evil.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />The fact this rank stack of hovels stands as the last safe place in the Fen is <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />testament to the Crone's evil legacy.

Title: A Weaver's Yarn
Description: Ask the citizens of Twillen about the Corpse Crone to pick up her trail.
PlayerPrompt: "I should ask around town as well."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />You should. Unfortunately, <g id="male_apologizeSmall" />many people lost faith in the knights during the Wars of Crimson Madness.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_bowShallow" priority="high"/>Good luck getting straight answers from these people. You'll need it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_flirtSmall" />Well, hello there! What brings you around these parts? Most people have better places to be than Weaver's Fen.

Title: Follow the Marsh Lights
Description: Follow the Marsh Lights to find the Corpse Crone's location.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />No, but people need someone to blame for their misery, and <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />they'll choose the easiest target.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Whatever your purpose in seeking the Corpse Crone, I hope she aids you as she did me.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />At first, I didn't recognize her, and even now I doubt my eyes. <g id="male_shakehead" />She is much changed, but there can be no doubt.

Title: Temple of the Crone
Description: Destroy the Arcane Anchors Morgaine uses to power the barrier at her cave.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />Indeed. Nothing could be more important! <g id="male_pointLeft" priority="high" />She believes she's safe behind this barrier, but <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I know her secrets.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_pointBlame" />Quickly now! We must destroy the anchors before she can strengthen the wards.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />Morgaine went to great lengths to protect her solitude… <g id="male_apologizeSmall" />those anchors were farther than expected, but <g id="male_pointLeft" priority="high" />this barrier must come down.

Title: A Face in the Mist
Description: Travel through the barrier at Morgaine's cave, tell her about your vision, and learn about Morgaine's past.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_hopeless" />I would hardly call it a confession! She has an explanation for <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />everything, of course, as she always did.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_shakehead" />If even half of what she claims is true, then <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />things are far different than I imagined.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_quidproquo" />So you see now that I have neither insight nor responsibility in whatever fate befell the High King.

Title: Old Wounds
Description: Convince Galahad that Morgaine's help is necessary before meeting Morgaine at Canopus.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Well, of course they do! It would be a shame if I spent all this time and could offer <g id="male_shrugBrief" />no value to them.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />I hope time has made Galahad more reasonable.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Ah, perfect. Among these ruins,<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" /> there are sources of power the Ancients learned to manipulate.

Title: The Power of Azoth
Description: Collect Ancient Shield Devices for Morgaine and meet her at the Ancient Device in Andrometus.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />Yes. The fountain of pure Azoth at this ruin dried long ago, <g id="female_youknow" />but its residual power remains in the waters and in the Guardians who protect the site.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />There should be several shield devices around Canopus. If they aren't charged, <g id="male_shrugBrief" />you can siphon energy from the Ancient Guardians.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You handled that quickly and without complaint. It's been a long time since I partnered with someone so… competent.

Title: Unexpected Prisoner
Description: Explore Andrometus to discover what has been imprisoned there.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_chuckle" />A glutton for danger, are you? <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />I hope you have some measure of restraint… but at the moment, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I'll take the bravado.
InProgressResponse: Whatever's causing the fault in the eldritch boundaries, it must be remedied.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Hm. Twice now, you solved problems without coming back to whine about some complication.

Title: The Source of the Blight
Description: Follow the trail of Blight back to its Source for Morgaine.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodding" />Yes, yes, yes. That adventurous spirit is definitely your weak spot, but once again, <g id="male_shrugBrief" />I'll take full advantage.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />Having second thoughts? If you want me to come with you, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />you'll have to wait some time.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />I can tell from here that the ruin and the Angry Earth who resided there are riddled with the Blight.

Title: Corruption Spreads its Hooks
Description: Travel back to Caer Dun to bring Yonas news from Morgaine.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodding" />Yes, of course, your fellow Soulwardens! <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />It will be critical that we strike back against the Corrupted with both a martial <g id="male_nodunderstand" />and a magical strategy.
InProgressResponse: I hope we are not too late in our efforts to combat the Corrupted.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I am grateful<g id="male_bowShallow" /> to have you returned, Soulwarden.<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> Hasty decisions have been made, and we need your insight.
